rationale: The fade thesis is intact — price remains ~4.4% below session VWAP, 6.4% off the high on 10.4x relative volume with a risk-off tape, and the bounce off the $40.60 LOD is unconvincing: the high-volume candle to $41.04 closed well off its peak (sellers absorbed it) and follow-through came on lighter volume, exactly the anemic-bounce pattern the entry anticipated. At 4 minutes old and roughly breakeven with zero adverse excursion, there is no mechanical reason to pay the 17 bps spread to exit, and flipping long would fight sub-VWAP distribution toward the $38.89 gap fill. Risk remains well-defined at the $41.85 invalidation.
